results.content:
Account Access Recovery for Locked Accounts

Locked accounts are a common issue, but resolving them doesn't have to be difficult. Follow these steps to help your colleagues get back to work.

1. Contact our IT Support team: Let us know about the locked account by submitting a ticket.
2. Verify Your Identity: You'll need to confirm your identity through our secure authentication process to protect your account.
3. Reset Your Password: You will then be guided through our approved procedure for resetting your password.

Remember, regular password changes are good practice and help keep your account safe. We recommend setting up a password manager if you haven't done so already. This way, you can generate strong passwords for different accounts without the need to remember them all.
